hypothesis: Reading each routed expert from experts.qc, already in the Metal graph's slot layout with its scales, in one read, instead of reading its two checkpoint tensors and repacking the weights, makes a 512-token prompt faster on an 8 GB M1, with the same logits.
model: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration) converted to Colibri's qwen36 container: INT4 routed experts with gs=64 group scales, f16 dense weights (quantized to INT8 at load) and f16 embedding; 23 GB of safetensors; canonical.qc beside it (1.94 GB, written by qwen36-canonical) and experts.qc (17.1 GB, scales as 16-bit codes): the bytes this branch's qwen36-canonical --experts writes, its records those of the conversion of 2026-10-03 by the same record code (experts-write.txt), the file rewritten in place with the same bytes on 2026-10-05 at 05:50, and its 8-byte stamp rewritten in place on 2026-10-07 to this code's; the checkpoint's shards were written on 2026-09-16
command: git archive ca1a863b c | tar -x -C <dir>, make -C <dir>/c qwen36_metal.o backend_metal.o METAL=1, then from the repository root, with the compiler flags make -C c qwen36 METAL=1 gives qwen36.c except its qpack path (-DQWEN36_QPACK and its objects, which the harness does not use): clang -O3 -Xclang -fopenmp -I<libomp>/include -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -Wno-misleading-indentation -Wno-unused-function -DCOLI_METAL -DQWEN36_METAL -I<dir>/c docs/experiments/qwen36-experts-file-2026-10-05/bench.c <dir>/c/qwen36_metal.o <dir>/c/backend_metal.o -o <dir>/qwen36-bench -lm -L<libomp>/lib -lomp -framework Metal -framework Foundation -framework Accelerate -lc++; every run: /usr/bin/time -l env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=$HOME SNAP=<model> <dir>/qwen36-bench promessi_sposi.txt 64,512 32; baseline = the same binary with QWEN36_EXPERTS_QC=0, through bin-checkpoint/qwen36-bench, a script with the one line QWEN36_EXPERTS_QC=0 exec bin-pr8/qwen36-bench "$@", trial = the defaults, with experts.qc beside the model

hardware.cpu: Apple M1, 4 performance + 4 efficiency cores (MacBook Air, MacBookAir10,1, no fan)

config.SNAP: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Colibri qwen36 container, INT4 experts gs=64, internal SSD
config.BUILD: the compiler flags of make -C c qwen36 METAL=1 on macOS without its qpack path: clang -O3 -Xclang -fopenmp -DCOLI_METAL -DQWEN36_METAL, qwen36_metal.o and backend_metal.o
config.EXPERT_CACHE: the Metal graph's default: a sixteenth of the RAM (512 MiB, 303 slots of 1.77 MB in both versions)
config.PROMPT: the first 64 and the first 512 tokens of promessi_sposi.txt (speed-bench/promessi_sposi.txt of antirez's ds4 at commit 0aaea5a, of which the harness reads the first 20,480 bytes; prompt_hash is its SHA-256), each from an empty state; after each, 32 greedy tokens
config.ORDER: 1 warm-up run (baseline, discarded), then baseline trial trial baseline baseline trial trial baseline, one process each
config.REST: thermal state nominal, then 60 s, before every run
config.EXPERT_SOURCE: the checkpoint's int4 weights and scales, repacked into the slot layout (QWEN36_EXPERTS_QC=0)
config.MEASURED: tokens per second reading the 512-token prompt from an empty state

quality.method: FNV-1a fingerprint of every logit of the run, and the hash of the generated tokens, per prompt length: 64 tokens 9585b2736ec3699f/1190b702cc495428, 512 tokens 465ed0efdf92a690/d37fd94c2856ba1a, the same in all nine runs (the warm-up and the 4 runs of each version)
